title: FUS post-transcriptional splicing is autoregulated via RNA condensation with therapeutic potential for ALS-FUS
authors: Huang W; Kumar V; Yap K; An H; John SJ; Hodgson RE; Avila AS; Day E; Ellis BC; Chung TH; Lord J; Müller-McNicoll M; Makeyev EV; Shelkovnikova TA
one_liner_zh: 该文研究FUS基因内含子RNA通过m6A/YTHDC1形成核内凝聚体并调控自身剪接，涉及RNA凝聚体与蛋白互作，但对象为RNA而非无序蛋白，且方法以实验为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟建模，故评5分。
abstract: Mutations in the FUS gene cause aggressive and often juvenile forms of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS-FUS). In addition to mRNA, the FUS gene gives rise to a partially processed RNA with retained introns 6 and 7. We demonstrate that these FUSint6&7-RNAs form nuclear condensates scaffolded by the highly structured intron 7 and associated with nuclear speckles. Using hybridization-proximity labelling proteomics, we show that the FUSint6&7-RNA condensates are enriched in splicing factors and the m6A reader YTHDC1. These ribonucleoprotein structures facilitate post-transcriptional FUS splicing and depend on m6A/YTHDC1 for their maintenance. FUSint6&7-RNAs become hypermethylated in cells expressing mutant FUS, leading to their enhanced condensation and consequently, splicing. We further demonstrate that FUS protein is repelled by m6A. Thus, ALS-FUS mutations may cause an abnormal activation of FUS post-transcriptional splicing via altered RNA methylation. Strikingly, ectopic expression of FUS intron 6&7 sequences dissolves the endogenous FUSint6&7-RNA condensates, downregulating FUS mRNA and protein. Overall, we describe an RNA condensation-dependent mechanism regulating FUS splicing that can be harnessed for developing new therapies.
abstract_zh: FUS基因的突变会导致侵袭性强且常为青少年型的肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS-FUS）。除了mRNA外，FUS基因还产生一种部分加工的RNA，其中保留了内含子6和7。我们证明这些FUSint6&7-RNA形成核凝聚体，其支架由高度结构化的内含子7构成，并与核斑点（nuclear speckles）相关联。利用杂交邻近标记蛋白质组学，我们显示FUSint6&7-RNA凝聚体富含剪接因子和m6A阅读器YTHDC1。这些核糖核蛋白结构促进FUS的转录后剪接，并依赖m6A/YTHDC1来维持其稳定性。在表达突变FUS的细胞中，FUSint6&7-RNA发生过度甲基化，导致其凝聚增强，进而促进剪接。我们进一步证明FUS蛋白被m6A排斥。因此，ALS-FUS突变可能通过改变RNA甲基化，异常激活FUS的转录后剪接。引人注目的是，FUS内含子6&7序列的异位表达会溶解内源性FUSint6&7-RNA凝聚体，下调FUS mRNA和蛋白水平。总体而言，我们描述了一种依赖RNA凝聚的机制来调控FUS剪接，该机制可被利用于开发新疗法。
